info.name: Ibyacu Connect Midterm
info.description: Ibyacu Connect Backend - HIRWA MUTEMBEREZI Gad (27338). One request per requirement, named by its ID.

request.description: Get one service request by id (CRUD). The full CRUD set is in the folder 'A2 - CRUD for the five entities'.

item.name: Error cases
item.description: One failing request for each requirement that has an error response (404, 400 or 409).

item.name: Step 0 - Seed data
item.description: Run this folder ONCE, in order, with the Collection Runner, right after Part A2 is working and before Part D is added (Part D blocks dates in the past).

item.name: Load ids
item.description: Run this folder after every import of the collection. It reads the ids from the database and stores them in collection variables.

item.name: A2 - CRUD for the five entities
item.description: Save, list, get, update and delete a temporary record of each entity. Run the whole folder in order; the last request of each group deletes the temporary record so the seed data stays as Step 0 requires.
